analysis_result.analysis: The model misinterprets the temporal sequence of the video, assuming that the reappearance of colored lines after 0:08 represents new drawings, when in fact the ground truth confirms that all 5 ropes were fully drawn by 0:05 and then began fading out. The model’s reasoning falsely treats each color’s reappearance as a new line, leading to an overcount of 10 instead of the correct 5. This reflects a failure in temporal event ordering and a breakdown in object permanence tracking — the model does not recognize that the same 5 ropes are simply being redrawn or re-displayed for visual emphasis, not newly generated.
